resolution.reason: The footer wording is set by the orchestrator decision recorded in the T7-03 notes (ralph orchestrator 2026-11-14T21:24:28Z): "The footer keeps T0-05's 'Bundle version: <bundle_version>' and appends ' · Schema <schema_version>'." site-footer.tsx renders exactly that, and page-check.ts asserts it as the whole text of the one <footer>, which make web-smoke passes. The finding itself calls it a literal-reading difference already rebutted (claude-r2-1, claude-r3-1, claude-r4-1).
